content: Filator sarme Isar bisar
Bade hitara dol šoho beggune uṛi Isare Rom šašok Filator hãse loigiye.
Ar hitara Isar berudde en hoi nališ goijje, "Ãra dekki ei manušwaye ãrar zatire kufõtot loi zargoi. Romor badšare hazna no dibolla mainšore mana gorer, ar nizore Mosi edde badša dabi gorer."
Toi Filate Isare fusar goredde, "Tui ki Ihudi okkolor badša?" Isaye Filatore zuwabe hodde,
Toi Filate ḍõr imam okkolore edde manušor dolore hodde, "Ãi ei manušwar hono hosuri no fair."
Kintu hitara zid gori howa šuru goijje, "Ehudiya elehar har zaga okkolot šikka di di ite manuš okkolore gonḍogul bazaider. Ite in Galilottu loti šuru goijje, ar ehon eṛe aišše."
Ei hota funi, Filate manušwa Galilor ne ki hoi fusar goijje.
Isa badša Herudor šašonor tole asede zani fari Filate Isare Herudor hãse faṭai diye. Ar he šomot Herud Zeruzalemot aššil.
Isa Herudor sarme

Badša Herude Isare deki beša beši kuši oiye, kiyollahoile hite Isar babute bout hota funnil, ar bout din dori hite Isare saibolla issa gori aššil. Ar Herude aša goijje Isaye hono keramot gori dehaibo.
Herude Isattu bout suwal okkol fusar goijje, kintu Isaye hitare hono zuwab no de.
Ar ḍõr imam edde alem okkol tiyaiyore Isare beši hosuri diya šuru goijje.
Toi Herud edde hitar šena okkole o Isare ofoman goijje edde ṭaṭṭa goijje. Toi Herude Isare raz fušak findai abar Filator hãse faṭai diye.
Hedin Herud edde Filat hitara ekzon loi ekzon dusto oi giyegoi, hiyar age hitarar butore dušmonai baf aššil.
Filate Isare kurušot dibar rai funaiye
Tarfore Filate ḍõr iman okkol, neta okkol edde manuš okkolore ekkui fũwati ḍaki,

hitarare hodde, "Tũwara itare ãr hãse ainno edde hoiyo, ei manušwaye manuš okkolore kufõtot loizar. Ar so, ãi tũwarar šaikkat bisar gorile o, tũwara hitar uwore ze šob duš okkol dor, hinor butore ei manušwar hono hosuri no fair.
Ar Herude o no fa. Hetolla Herude itare ãr hãse uwafes faṭaiyede. Ar so, ei manušwaye moron šaza faibar laikka o kissu no gore.
Hetolla ãi hitare šasti diyore eri diyum."
(Filate ei šob hota hoiyede haron oilde he idor ṭaimot hitaralla ekzonore eridiya oito.)
Kintu hitara dol šoho beggune uzor diyore hodde, "Itare dur goro, ãralla Barabbasore sari do."
Ei Barabbas zare šohoror maze danga edde kunor harone ziyolot bondi gori raka oiye.
Deš šasiyot goroya Filate Isare eri dito saiye hetolla abar hite mainšor dolor hãse zanaiye.
Kintu manuš okkole guzori hodde, "Itare kurušot do! Kurušot do! Itare mari felo!"
Filate tin mottor barot hodde, "Kiyolla? Ite hosuri ki goijje? Ãi hitare šazaye mout dibar hono hosuri no dekir, hetolla ãi itare šasti di eri diyum."
Kintu Isare kurušot diya oibolla hitara zid gori beši uzor diya šuru goijje. Toi hitarar uzor kamiyaf oiye.
Filate hitarar issa mozin goribar hokum di felaiye.
Danga edde kungorar harone ze Barabbasore ziyolot raka oil, hitara hitare saiye. Toi Filate hitare hitaralla eri diye, kintu Isare mari felaibolla tuli diye. Hitarar issa furon oiye.
Isare kurušot diya or
Tarfore hitara Isare loi zadde šomot Šimon name ekzon Kuronir manuš farar butottu di aiššil. Hitara Isar fise fise kuruš boi loi zaibolla he manušwar handot kuruš tuli diye.
Ar bout mainšor dol okkol fise fise giye. Hitarar butore bout mayafuwain okkol aššil, zara Isalla bilag gorer edde šuk tuli hander.
Kintu Isaye hitarar mikka firiyore hodde,

content.text: "O Zeruzalemor hoinna okkol, ãlla no haindo, bolke nizolla edde nizor nizor fuwaindolla hando.
Kiyollahoile so en šomoi aiyer zẽtte tũwara hoiba, 'Šuki he bázá mayafuwain okkol, zarar udore hono fuwain no owa, zarar buke hono din dud no de!'
Ar mura okkolore hoibo, "Ãrare guri rak!"'
Kiyollahoile mainše hail gasor uwore zodi en gore, toile fuwana gasor uwore ki no goṭibo?"

content: Aro dusora duizon ašami manušore o Isar fũwati mari felaibolla loi za oiye.
Hitara Matakuli name ek zagat fõsi bade heṛe šena okkole Isa edde he duizon ašamire kurušot loṭkaiye, ekzonore Isar ḍen ḍake ar ekzonore bam ḍake gori.
Hetunot Isaye Allare hodde:

content.text: "Ya Bab, itarare maf goro, kiyollahoile itara ki gorer hin itara no zane."

content: Bade šena okkole Isar horgunore loṭari kelai bag goijje.
Manuš okkole tiyai sai taikke, kintu Ihudi neta okkole Isare loi ṭaṭṭa goijje edde hodde: "Ite oinno manuš okkolore basaito, zodi hite Allar he Mosi, Allar basai gora, toile ehon hite nizore basaok."
Ar šena okkole Isare horor roš dito saiye edde hitara ṭaṭṭa gori hodde,
"Tui zodi Ihudi okkolor badša os, toile nizore basa."
Ar Isar matar uwore ekkan sainboṛot mari diya aššil ziyanot leka ase: "Iba Ihudi okkolor badša."
Ar ze duizon hosurbonore kurušot ṭaikke, hitarar butore ekzone ṭiṭkari di Isare hodde, "Tui Mosi no ne? Tui nizore edde ãrare basasena!"
Kintu ar ekzon ze ase hite itare zejjeṛai hodde, "Tui šaza for, to ki Allare o boi no goros?
Ãra usit šaza fair, zin goijji hinor fól hisabe. Kintu Isayede hono kuham no gore."
Tarfore hite Isare hodde, "Huzur Isa, õne zẽtte nizor raijjot oiba hẽtte ãre monot raikko."
Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tore soiyi hoir, aijja tui ãr fũwati zonnotot oibi."

content: Isar moron
Hẽtte šomoi onumanik dũjja, beilore ganda doijje. Ar šara deš tin gonḍa mula andar oi taikke.
dórmogóror forodagan uwottu loti siri dui bag oi giyegoi.
Isaye guzori hodde:

content.text: "Oh Baf, ãi tũwar hatot ãr ruh tuli dilam."

content: Ei hota hoi bade Isaye hibar šeš niyaš felaiye.
Ei šob hanḍo deki ekzon Romor šenar boroye Allare tarif gori hodde, "Hãsa ei manušwa soiyi aššil."
Ar ze šomosto manuš okkole ei hanḍo saibolla zoma oiye, hitara zin zin goiṭṭe hin okkol deki buk bajjai bajjai henttu giyegoi.
Ar Isar sin foriso zara edde ze mayafuwain okkol Isar fũwati Galilottu aišše, hitara šoho beggune dure tiyai in okkol saiye.
Isare hobor diya or
Ar heṛe Yusuf name ekzon manuš aššil, dórmo komitir ekzon ze bala edde soiyi.
Komitir mainše hormo hanḍo, solla mošora zin Isar babute goijje hinot ei manušwaye razi oi no fare. hiba aššilde Ehudiyar Arimatiya farar manuš. Hibaye Allar raijjolla boi aššil.
Hiba Filator hãse zaiyore Isar lašwalla saiye.
Bade laš lamai kafonor hoor berai di fattorot kuinda, en ek hoborot raikkegoi, zeṛe honokiyore age heṛe raka no o.
He din dórmo dinor tiyarir din, dórmor din onumanik šuru oi giyegoi.
Isar fũwati ze mayafuwain okkol Galilottu aiššil hitara Yusufor kure kure zai he hobor edde ki bafe Isar laš raka oiye hin saiyegoi.
Bade hitara firi giye edde kušbo mollom edde tel banaiye. Tarfore dórmor din Musar ain mozin hitara ziraiye.
